answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. It is effective because voting power is weighted by verifiable work over time, so a fresh flood of accounts cannot manufacture a decisive vote. Consider a spiral as the anchor of the cost.
